mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior 3 months compresses discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days when the rate trend is downward.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS declines over the prior 3 months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A labor market contraction signaled by unemployment rate falling below 4.0% in the prior month indicates robust economic conditions, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE falls below 4.0% in the prior month, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 2-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) above their 3-month moving averages indicates strong consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS exceed 3-month moving averages, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 5-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, industrial production (INDPRO) exceeding 100.5 for two consecutive months signals robust manufacturing activity, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO exceeds 100.5 during late-cycle expansion, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) over the prior 3 months indicates expanding labor market conditions, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where PAYEMS increases over the prior 3 months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 5-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) year-over-year increase exceeding 3.0% signals inflationary pressure that triggers central bank rate hikes, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL YoY exceeds 3.0%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in FEDFUNDS below 4.5% and CPIAUCSL YoY exceeding 3.0% indicates monetary policy response to overheating, driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS < 4.5% and CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 5-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle, FEDFUNDS above 4.5% combined with CPIAUCSL YoY exceeding 3.0% signals aggressive rate policy, driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 4.5% and CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0% during monetary tightening, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year windows.
